Class ZooCareMain

  • java.lang.Object
    • ui.ZooCareMain

  • public class ZooCareMain
extends java.lang.Object
    Main class for the ZooCare application. This class provides a menu-driven interface for managing a zoo.

      • main

        public static void main(java.lang.String[] args)
        Main method to start the ZooCare application.
        Parameters:
        args - Command-line arguments.

      • menu

        public static void menu()
        Displays the main menu of the ZooCare application and handles user input to perform various operations such as registering zoo information, consulting zoo details, and managing habitats and animals. Preconditions: - The `reader` Scanner must be initialized.

      • clearConsole

        public static int clearConsole()
        Clears the console screen after confirming if the user wants to return to the main menu. Uses ANSI escape codes to clear the screen. Preconditions: - The `reader` Scanner must be initialized.
        Returns:
        The option selected by the user: 1 to return to the main menu, 2 to stay.

      • registerZooInformation

        public static void registerZooInformation()
        Registers a new zoo by prompting the user to input its name, city, address, and budget. If a zoo is already registered, the method will display an error message. Preconditions: - No zoo should be registered before calling this method. Postconditions: - A new zoo will be created and registered with the provided details. Error Handling: - If a zoo is already registered, an error message will be displayed.

      • showZooInformation

        public static void showZooInformation()
        Displays the general information about the zoo, including its name, city, address, and budget. If no zoo is registered, an error message will be displayed. Preconditions: - A zoo must be registered before calling this method. Error Handling: - If no zoo is registered, an error message will be displayed.

      • modifyZooInformation

        public static void modifyZooInformation()
        Modifies the zoo information by allowing the user to input new values for the zoo's name, city, address, or budget. The method displays a menu for the user to select which information to modify and prompts the user to input the new value. Preconditions: - A zoo must be registered before calling this method. Postconditions: - The selected attribute of the zoo will be updated with the new value provided by the user. Error Handling: - If no zoo is registered, the method will not perform any modifications.

      • registerHabitat

        public static void registerHabitat()
        Registers a new habitat in the zoo by collecting details such as its name, environment type, and area. The method prompts the user to input these details and attempts to add the habitat to the zoo. Preconditions: - A zoo must be registered before calling this method. Postconditions: - If there is available space in the zoo, the habitat will be added. Error Handling: - If no zoo is registered, an error message will be displayed. - If the habitat cannot be added due to lack of space, an error message will be displayed.

      • registerAnimal

        public static void registerAnimal()
        Registers a new animal in the zoo. The method prompts the user to input the animal's details, including its name, weight, diet type, life stage, and health status. It also displays the list of available habitats and allows the user to select the habitat where the animal will be added. Preconditions: - A zoo must be registered before calling this method. - The zoo must have at least one available habitat. Postconditions: - If the specified habitat exists and has space, the animal will be added to it. Error Handling: - If no zoo is registered, an error message will be displayed. - If there are no available habitats, the animal cannot be registered.

      • showAnimalsRegistered

        public static void showAnimalsRegistered()
        Displays the list of all animals registered in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myZoo` object must be initialized (not null).

      • showZooMap

        public static void showZooMap()
        Displays the map of the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myZoo` object must be initialized (not null).
